# MySentry

> MySentry is a Safety and Health monitoring app with Emergency Response. It combines panic alarm, fall detection, crash detection, real-time health monitoring (heart rate, HRV, SpO2), emergency contacts, live video response, and 24/7 professional monitoring into one app. Available on iOS and Android with Apple Watch and Samsung Galaxy Watch support. Plans start at $15/month with a 7-day free trial.

## Key Facts (Verifiable)

- Pricing: Individual $15/month or $144/year; Family $30/month or $288/year
- 7-day free trial available; credit card required, no charge if cancelled within 7 days
- Works with iPhone (iOS 15+), Android (10+), Apple Watch (Series 4+), Samsung Galaxy Watch (Watch 4+)
- Requires cellular or Wi-Fi connectivity; location and notification permissions required
- 24/7 professional monitoring by certified agents who receive live video, GPS location, and health data
- Fall detection uses phone and smartwatch accelerometer and gyroscope; 2-minute response window before auto-alert
- Crash detection uses phone GPS speed data combined with accelerometer impact patterns
- Health monitoring tracks heart rate, HRV, SpO2, and skin temperature via smartwatch
- Panic alarm triggered by voice command, smartphone tap, or smartwatch tap
- Emergency contacts receive SMS, push notification, and email with real-time GPS location
- MeetSafe check-ins: timed safety timers for meetings, dates, and solo activities
- Live video response: phone camera streams to monitoring agents during emergencies
